titles: Fix null pointer in checkout flow
Add integration tests for webhook handler
Revert breaking change to API client

list_child.name: lshistory
list_child.desc: Returns every build recorded in the repo's pipeline history. Use this when you need to walk through builds from every phase.

decoys.name: lsmergeq
decoys.desc: Returns every build waiting in the repo's merge queue. Use this when you need to see what is lined up to land on the main branch.

decoys.name: lsarchive
decoys.desc: Returns every build moved into the repo's cold storage archive. Use this when you need to dig up builds past the retention window.

decoys.name: lsreleases
decoys.desc: Returns every build promoted to the repo's release registry. Use this when you need to see which builds have shipped.

get_child.name: getrecord
get_child.desc: Retrieves one build's record by its id. It returns every field the pipeline currently stores for that build.

decoys.name: getlog
decoys.desc: Retrieves one build's console log by its id. It returns the full output the runner captured for that build.

decoys.name: getprovenance
decoys.desc: Retrieves one build's provenance record by its id. It returns the signed attestation the pipeline made for that build.

decoys.name: gettests
decoys.desc: Retrieves one build's test report by its id. It returns every test case result the pipeline recorded for that build.

list_parent.name: lsrepos
list_parent.desc: Returns every repo the CI system currently builds. Use this to enumerate repos before drilling into their builds.

decoys.name: lsforks
decoys.desc: Returns every fork the CI system currently builds. Use this to enumerate forks before drilling into their pull requests.

decoys.name: lsmirrors
decoys.desc: Returns every mirror the CI system currently syncs. Use this to enumerate mirrors before checking their sync health.

decoys.name: lstemplates
decoys.desc: Returns every template repo the CI system currently offers. Use this to enumerate starters before scaffolding a project.

get_parent.name: getrepometa
get_parent.desc: Retrieves one repo's metadata by its id. It returns everything the CI system currently tracks for that repo.

decoys.name: getrepoconfig
decoys.desc: Retrieves one repo's pipeline config by its id. It returns the YAML the CI system runs for that repo.

decoys.name: getreposecrets
decoys.desc: Retrieves one repo's secret inventory by its id. It returns the names of the secrets its pipelines can read.

decoys.name: getrepostats
decoys.desc: Retrieves one repo's build statistics by its id. It returns the pass rates and durations for that repo.

delete_child.name: rmbuild
delete_child.desc: Deletes a build record from the pipeline history permanently. There is no way to recover it once removed.

decoys.name: rmartifacts
decoys.desc: Deletes a build's uploaded artifacts from storage permanently. There is no way to recover them once removed.

decoys.name: rmlogs
decoys.desc: Deletes a build's console logs from the log store permanently. There is no way to recover them once removed.

decoys.name: rmcache
decoys.desc: Deletes a build's dependency cache from the runners permanently. There is no way to recover it once removed.

set_enum.name: setrunphase
set_enum.desc: Updates a build's run phase to queued, running, passed, or failed. This overwrites whatever run phase the build was previously in.

decoys.name: setgatephase
decoys.desc: Updates a build's gate phase to queued, running, passed, or failed. Deploys that depend on the build wait until it reaches that phase.

decoys.name: setbadgephase
decoys.desc: Updates a build's badge phase to queued, running, passed, or failed. This overwrites whatever the repo's status badge was showing.

decoys.name: setalertphase
decoys.desc: Updates a build's alert phase to queued, running, passed, or failed. The on-call contact is texted when the build reaches it.

set_bool.name: markflaky
set_bool.desc: Marks a build as flaky, meaning its result is unreliable from run to run. This is meant for builds with inconsistent pass/fail history.

decoys.name: markpinned
decoys.desc: Marks a build as pinned, meaning its artifacts are kept past the retention window. This is meant for builds that back a release.
verbs: keep the artifacts of {obj} past retention

decoys.name: marklocked
decoys.desc: Marks a build as locked, meaning nobody can rerun or cancel it. This is meant for builds that are under a compliance audit.

decoys.name: markcanary
decoys.desc: Marks a build as a canary, meaning its output rolls out to a small slice of traffic first. This is meant for risky changes.

set_ref.name: mvbuild
set_ref.desc: Reassigns a build record to a different repo. This is useful when a build was logged against the wrong repo.

decoys.name: pubbuild
decoys.desc: Publishes a build's artifacts into a different repo's package registry. This is useful when that repo ships them.

decoys.name: linkbuild
decoys.desc: Links a build as an upstream dependency of a different repo. This is useful when that repo consumes its output.

decoys.name: reportbuild
decoys.desc: Reports a build's status to a different repo's pull requests. This is useful when one change spans two repos.

send.name: textowner
send.desc: Sends a text message to the repo's on-call contact about a build. This is the fastest way to get a human's attention on a build issue.

decoys.name: callowner
decoys.desc: Places a phone call to the repo's on-call contact about a build. This is the most direct way to reach a human during an outage.

decoys.name: mailowner
decoys.desc: Sends an email to the repo's on-call contact about a build. This is the usual way to share a full build report for later reading.
child_verbs: mail the owner of {obj} a report

decoys.name: chatowner
decoys.desc: Posts a chat message to the repo's on-call contact about a build. This is the quickest way to open a thread in the team channel.
child_verbs: post in chat to the owner of {obj}

create.name: newbuild
create.desc: Creates a new build for a repo, with an optional commit message and starting phase. Use this when a pipeline run needs to be recorded by hand.

decoys.name: newrelease
decoys.desc: Creates a new release for a repo, with an optional commit message and starting phase. Use this when a tagged version needs to be cut by hand.

decoys.name: newdeploy
decoys.desc: Creates a new deployment for a repo, with an optional commit message and starting phase. Use this when a rollout needs to be recorded by hand.

decoys.name: newrollback
decoys.desc: Creates a new rollback for a repo, with an optional commit message and starting phase. Use this when a bad change needs to be backed out by hand.

list_notes.name: lsnotes
list_notes.desc: Returns the engineer notes attached to one build. Use this to read what the team has written about that build.

decoys.name: lscomments
decoys.desc: Returns the review comments attached to one build. Use this to read what reviewers have written about that build.

decoys.name: lsreleasenotes
decoys.desc: Returns the release notes attached to one build. Use this to read what ships to users with that build.

decoys.name: lsincidents
decoys.desc: Returns the incident notes attached to one build. Use this to read what on-call has written about that build.

add_note.name: addnote
add_note.desc: Attaches an engineer note to a build, with an optional title. Use this to record context the team will need later.

decoys.name: addcomment
decoys.desc: Attaches a review comment to a build, with an optional title. Use this to record feedback for the change author.

decoys.name: addreleasenote
decoys.desc: Attaches a release note to a build, with an optional title. Use this to record what users will see change.

decoys.name: addincident
decoys.desc: Attaches an incident note to a build, with an optional title. Use this to record an outage the build caused.

update_note.name: editnote
update_note.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of one engineer note on a build. Use this to correct or expand what was written.

decoys.name: editcomment
decoys.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of one review comment on a build. Use this to revise feedback already given.

decoys.name: editreleasenote
decoys.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of one release note on a build. Use this to reword what users will read.

decoys.name: editincident
decoys.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of one incident note on a build. Use this to update an outage write-up.

delete_note.name: rmnote
delete_note.desc: Removes one engineer note from a build permanently. There is no way to recover it once removed.

decoys.name: rmcomment
decoys.desc: Removes one review comment from a build permanently. There is no way to recover it once removed.

decoys.name: rmreleasenote
decoys.desc: Removes one release note from a build permanently. There is no way to recover it once removed.

decoys.name: rmincident
decoys.desc: Removes one incident note from a build permanently. There is no way to recover it once removed.

set_image.name: setpreview
set_image.desc: Sets the preview image shown on a build's page. Use this to attach a screenshot that sums up the build.

decoys.name: setvisualdiff
decoys.desc: Sets the visual diff image shown on a build's page. Use this to attach the snapshot comparison from UI tests.

decoys.name: setdepgraph
decoys.desc: Sets the dependency graph image shown on a build's page. Use this to attach the rendered module graph.

decoys.name: setheatmap
decoys.desc: Sets the coverage heatmap image shown on a build's page. Use this to attach the rendered coverage map.

writer.name: drafttext
writer.desc: Writes a short message from a brief, which says what to say in the requester's words, and the builds it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: writestatus
decoys.desc: Writes a short status message from a brief, which says what to report in the requester's words, and the builds it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: writepostmortem
decoys.desc: Writes a short postmortem from a brief, which says what happened in the requester's words, and the builds it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: writechangelog
decoys.desc: Writes a short changelog entry from a brief, which says what changed in the requester's words, and the builds it should mention. It returns the finished text.

image.name: genpicture
image.desc: Generates a picture from a prompt and returns its URL. An optional visual style can be passed to shape the result.

decoys.name: genvideo
decoys.desc: Generates a video from a prompt and returns its URL. An optional visual style can be passed to shape the result.

decoys.name: genpdf
decoys.desc: Generates a PDF document from a prompt and returns its URL. An optional visual style can be passed to shape the result.

decoys.name: findimage
decoys.desc: Finds a matching library image from a prompt and returns its URL. An optional visual style can narrow the pick.

search.name: searchdocs
search.desc: Searches the CI platform's help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use this to look up how the pipelines work.

decoys.name: searchrunbooks
decoys.desc: Searches the on-call runbooks with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use this to look up how to respond to an outage.

decoys.name: searchclouddocs
decoys.desc: Searches the cloud provider's help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use this to look up how a managed service behaves.

decoys.name: searchhostdocs
decoys.desc: Searches the code host's help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use this to look up how repository settings work.
